test.title: A memorable journey you made by public transport

document.cue: Describe a memorable journey you made by public transport.

text: The journey I remember best was a night train from Almaty to Astana that I took with two university friends last winter. We were going to a student conference, and since flights were expensive, we decided to go by train, even though it takes almost a whole day.

We travelled in a sleeper carriage with four bunks in each compartment. Our fourth neighbour turned out to be an elderly woman going to visit her grandchildren, and within an hour she had shared her homemade baursaks with us and told us half her life story.

The most memorable part, though, happened in the middle of the night. The train stopped in the open steppe for almost two hours because of a heavy snowstorm, and the heating in our carriage started to fail. Instead of complaining, everyone gathered in the corridor, passed around flasks of tea and told jokes until the train started moving again.

I think it stayed with me because it was such a contrast to normal travel. On a plane, nobody talks to each other, but on that train complete strangers became a kind of temporary family, and we arrived exhausted but strangely happy.
We were late for the opening of the conference, but none of us regretted taking the train for a second.

tips.en: Turned out to be is a handy phrase for surprises in a story.
tips.kk: Turned out to be — оқиғадағы тосын сәттерге ыңғайлы тіркес.
tips.ru: Turned out to be — удобный оборот для сюрпризов в истории.
tips.example: turned out to be an elderly woman

tips.en: On a plane, nobody talks to each other explains why the journey was special.
tips.kk: On a plane, nobody talks to each other — салыстыру сапардың неге ерекше екенін түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: On a plane, nobody talks to each other — сравнение объясняет, почему поездка особенная.
tips.example: On a plane, nobody talks to each other

note.en: Where and how — the first two bullets at once, plus why they chose the train.
note.kk: Қайда және немен — алғашқы екі тармақ бірден және пойызды таңдау себебі.
note.ru: Куда и на чём — оба первых пункта сразу и причина выбрать поезд.

note.en: The transport from the inside — the carriage, the compartment and the fellow passenger with baursaks.
note.kk: Көлік ішінен — вагон, купе және бауырсақ ұсынған бірге жол жүрген әже.
note.ru: Транспорт изнутри — вагон, купе и попутчица с баурсаками.

note.en: What happened — the key scene: a snowstorm, a long stop, tea in the corridor.
note.kk: Не болды — басты көрініс: боран, пойыздың ұзақ тоқтап қалуы, дәліздегі шай.
note.ru: Что случилось — главная сцена: буран, долгая остановка, чай в коридоре.

note.en: Why it was memorable — a contrast with flying.
A light ending with some irony: late, but with no regrets.
note.kk: Әзілі бар жеңіл қорытынды: кешікті, бірақ өкінбейді.
note.ru: Лёгкий итог с иронией: опоздали, но не жалеют.
